title: Demonstrate 2jn's A1 and A5 live: ticfac init + ticfac run in herdr on claude, and one epic via ticfac run --cloud
description: Carried from 2jn's tm5 (finding 08a0146a, rrl attempt 54): 2jn's A1 (ticfac init then ticfac run <epic> in herdr panes on claude) and A5 (run --cloud) were tested with stand-ins, never live. A worker cannot do this (it means running a whole other epic and a cloud run from inside a tick), so the operator does it: run the next local epic (6in) with ticfac init + ticfac run in herdr on claude, and u9h's first real cloud run with ticfac run --cloud. Record the evidence (commands, run ids, outcome) here.
acceptance_criteria: One epic ran start to finish via 'ticfac run' in herdr on claude, and one via 'ticfac run --cloud', on a binary that includes 2jn; the run ids and outcomes are noted on this tick
